newsitem.title: USA: LSB Bancshares to buy Old North State for $30 million.
newsitem.headline: LSB Bancshares to buy Old North State for $30 million.

text.p: LSB Bancshares Inc. said Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Old North State Bank of Winston-Salem, N.C., for $30 million in stock.
Under the agreement, Old North State Bank stockholders would receive 0.948 share of LSB common stock for each of their shares.
The transaction values Old North shares at $18.96 each, based on LSB's recent trading price of $20 per share.
Following the news, LSB's stock lost $1.50 to $19 while Old North State jumped $3 to $18.25 on the Nasdaq.
The merger is expected to be completed by mid-1997, LSB said.

LSB Bancshares, with $426 million in assets, is the holding company for Lexington State Bank, and North State Bank has $128 million in assets, with 7 branch offices located in Forsyth and Stokes Counties, N.C.
